rationale: Task T2 requires a comprehensive portfolio description covering claim volumes and status distribution, denial rate, fraud prevalence, and financial metrics across billed/allowed/paid amounts, plus monthly claim volume trends. The plan loads tables, quantifies claims by status with the status distribution figure, calculates denial and fraud rates against all claims (the most inclusive denominator), summarizes all three financial amount columns at sum and mean level, computes monthly trends in both claim count and paid amounts, and synthesizes all findings into a one-page report with denominators shown and artifact citations for transparency.
